briefTitle: New Treatment Strategies and Epigenetic Biomarker for Management of Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia
officialTitle: A Phase 2b Randomized, Single-Center, Double Blind, Placebo Controlled, 2-Arm Study to Investigate Orally Administered Combination Therapies (5-alpha Reductase Inhibitor + Raloxifene) Compared With Monotherapy (5-alpha Reductase Inhibitor + Placebo) in Adult Patients With Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia (BPH)

arms.label: Finasteride + Inactive Placebo Monotherapy
